exchanges: morning! slept like a rock for once
Love that, a good night's sleep changes everything.
work's been nuts, being the only cartographer on the team means every map lands on my desk
That's a lot on your plate, hope it calms down soon.
my cousin Jo just got a whippet puppy and its all legs
Puppies at that gangly stage are adorable.
my gf Isolde says we need a dog too. i said absolutely not lol
Sounds like that debate isn't over yet!
she's very persuasive tho
Ha, you might lose this one.
mum's been laid up with shingles all week, poor thing
Oh no, I hope she feels better soon.
taking her soup later
That's really kind of you.
mum was telling me about growing up in Ardmore, sounded so peaceful
Small-town childhood stories are the best.
anyway rainy afternoon, nothing planned
Perfect excuse for a lazy one.
Jo from work brought her basenji to the office today, it does this yodel thing
That's such a funny sound for a dog to make!
night classes at Brindlewood start next week, kinda nervous
Totally normal to be nervous, you'll do great.
Priya's been playing Stereolab nonstop in the car
Sounds like she's found her soundtrack.
grabbed takeout, to tired to cook
Sometimes that's the right call.
my brother Thaddeus called, first time in ages
That must have been nice to hear from him.
he's doing ok i think
Glad to hear it.
Priya told me shes relocating to Lockridge in the spring
Big change for her, you'll miss having her close.
gonna miss her honestly
It's hard when friends move away.
my gf wants to plan a weekend trip before then
A trip sounds like a great idea.
phone died twice today, my Fairphone battery is on its last legs
At least the battery on those is easy to swap.
ordered a new battery for it
Good call, much cheaper than a new phone.
ok groceries done
Nice, one less thing to do.
thinking of making a curry tonight
Curry sounds perfect for this weather.
mum sounded better on the phone btw
That's really good news.
also i caved and bought a kayak, its sitting in the garage lol
Ha, now you just need some sunny weekends!

Priya lives where at the moment
